description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English
The port used for health checks.
The name of the Nacos cluster.
The type of the health check.

description.zh: 是否使用实例端口进行健康检查。
description.en: Specifies whether to use the port of the instance for a health check.
